newsitem.title: JAPAN: FORECAST-Japan trade surplus to dip further in Aug.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Japan trade surplus to dip further in Aug.

text.p: Japan's contentious trade surplus is likely to continue its slide in August as growth in imports is seen far exceeding that of exports, analysts said.

A Reuter poll of analysts showed that Japan's customs-cleared trade surplus is projected to be between 160 billion and 314 billion yen in August after a surplus of 535.14 billion a year earlier. The August trade data is due at 8.50 a.m. on Wednesday (2350 GMT on Tuesday).
"Imports are expected to stay buoyant, although the tempo of its growth may be slowing," said Shuji Shirota, an economist at Yamaichi Research Institute of Securities and Economics.
